notifications.title: YouTube raises the monetisation bar on 1 Feb 2027: the long videos become this channel's realistic route
notifications.detail: Per YouTube's Partner Program overhaul (announced 10 Aug 2026, reported by Metricool, Cartoon Brew and AIR Media-Tech), channels applying after 31 Jan 2027 need 1,000 subscribers plus 8,000 watch hours in 365 days (now 4,000) or 20M Shorts views in 90 days (now 10M); Shorts revenue also needs 10M qualified Shorts views every 90 days. This channel (2 Shorts published, 161 views) can't reach the old bar by 31 Jan, so the weekly 12-15 min long video is its path: 8,000 hours is about 40,000 full views of a 12-minute video. Nothing in the AI-label rules affects us (they cover photorealistic AI; ours is clearly animated).
notifications.fix: 1. No action needed now. 2. When you review strategy, weigh long-video cadence over Shorts volume for this channel. 3. Check YouTube's own YPP page in January for the final wording.
